title: AI Use by Country 2026: Adoption Across the World - research data
compiled_by: Report AI research agent (read-only; nothing written to WordPress)

confidence_key.HIGH: primary source or primary dataset opened
confidence_key.DERIVED: Report AI arithmetic; formula in note

primary_metric_definition: Microsoft 'AI user share' / 'AI diffusion': 'the share of people worldwide between ages 15 and 64 who have used a generative AI product during the reported period. This measure is derived from aggregated and anonymized Microsoft telemetry and is adjusted to reflect differences in operating system and device market share, internet penetration, and population' (Q2 2026 blog/report, 21 Sep 2026; same wording in Q1 2026; the Jan 2026 H2 2025 blog omits the age band but the report tables use working-age population). Technical paper (Misra et al., arXiv 2511.02781, 4 Nov 2025): AI User Share = (% of Microsoft telemetry users, mainly Windows PC/tablet, who visit listed AI sites) x (% of working-age population with a desktop device, from Windows monthly active devices / StatCounter Windows share) x (country mobile-to-desktop scaling from StatCounter traffic ratios), minus an estimated desktop-mobile overlap assuming independence (the paper notes this may slightly overstate the total). Only telemetry users with at least 90 minutes of total usage in the month are counted; countries with below-average telemetry opt-in ('particularly in parts of Europe') are blended toward the global average; denominator is World Bank WDI population aged 15-64. It is not a survey and measures desktop-observed visits to 19 named AI sites/apps (Nov 2025 list: Alice, ChatGPT, Character.ai, Claude, CLOVA X, DeepSeek, ERNIE Bot, GigaChat, Gemini, Grok, Khanmigo, Meta.ai, Copilot, Midjourney, Mistral, NanoSemantics, Perplexity, Tongyi Qianwen, Xiaowei) - Doubao, Kimi and Yuanbao are not on that list, consistent with Microsoft's Q2 2026 statement that several widely used Chinese domestic tools are excluded and will be added in the next edition. [11 Nov ET verification]

statcounter_ai_chatbot_referral_share_oc.source: StatCounter Global Stats, AI Chatbot Market Share (country page)
statcounter_ai_chatbot_referral_share_oc.note: StatCounter 'AI chatbot market share' = share of page views REFERRED by AI chatbots (a user clicks a link in a chatbot answer through to a website) on the 1M+ websites running StatCounter's tracker (3bn+ page views/month), all platforms. It measures which chatbot sends traffic onward, not how many people use each chatbot or how often. Grok is excluded because it passes no referrer; Meta AI, Doubao, Alice, GigaChat, CLOVA X and other local assistants are not listed. Example of the gap: StatCounter shows ChatGPT at 42.59% in China in Oct 2026, where ChatGPT is not available - referrals come from the small VPN/overseas population visiting StatCounter-tagged sites.

statcounter_ai_chatbot_referral_share_oc.source: StatCounter Global Stats, AI Chatbot Market Share (country page)
statcounter_ai_chatbot_referral_share_oc.note: StatCounter 'AI chatbot market share' = share of page views REFERRED by AI chatbots (a user clicks a link in a chatbot answer through to a website) on the 1M+ websites running StatCounter's tracker (3bn+ page views/month), all platforms. It measures which chatbot sends traffic onward, not how many people use each chatbot or how often. Grok is excluded because it passes no referrer; Meta AI, Doubao, Alice, GigaChat, CLOVA X and other local assistants are not listed. Example of the gap: StatCounter shows ChatGPT at 42.59% in China in Oct 2026, where ChatGPT is not available - referrals come from the small VPN/overseas population visiting StatCounter-tagged sites.

statcounter_ai_chatbot_referral_share_oc.note: StatCounter 'AI chatbot market share' = share of page views REFERRED by AI chatbots (a user clicks a link in a chatbot answer through to a website) on the 1M+ websites running StatCounter's tracker (3bn+ page views/month), all platforms. It measures which chatbot sends traffic onward, not how many people use each chatbot or how often. Grok is excluded because it passes no referrer; Meta AI, Doubao, Alice, GigaChat, CLOVA X and other local assistants are not listed. Example of the gap: StatCounter shows ChatGPT at 42.59% in China in Oct 2026, where ChatGPT is not available - referrals come from the small VPN/overseas population visiting StatCounter-tagged sites.

statcounter_ai_chatbot_referral_share_oc.source: StatCounter Global Stats, AI Chatbot Market Share (country page)
statcounter_ai_chatbot_referral_share_oc.note: StatCounter 'AI chatbot market share' = share of page views REFERRED by AI chatbots (a user clicks a link in a chatbot answer through to a website) on the 1M+ websites running StatCounter's tracker (3bn+ page views/month), all platforms. It measures which chatbot sends traffic onward, not how many people use each chatbot or how often. Grok is excluded because it passes no referrer; Meta AI, Doubao, Alice, GigaChat, CLOVA X and other local assistants are not listed. Example of the gap: StatCounter shows ChatGPT at 42.59% in China in Oct 2026, where ChatGPT is not available - referrals come from the small VPN/overseas population visiting StatCounter-tagged sites.

It measures which chatbot sends traffic onward, not how many people use each chatbot or how often. Grok is excluded because it passes no referrer; Meta AI, Doubao, Alice, GigaChat, CLOVA X and other local assistants are not listed. statcounter_ai_chatbot_referral_share_oc.source: StatCounter Global Stats, AI Chatbot Market Share (country page)
statcounter_ai_chatbot_referral_share_oc.note: StatCounter 'AI chatbot market share' = share of page views REFERRED by AI chatbots (a user clicks a link in a chatbot answer through to a website) on the 1M+ websites running StatCounter's tracker (3bn+ page views/month), all platforms. It measures which chatbot sends traffic onward, not how many people use each chatbot or how often. Grok is excluded because it passes no referrer; Meta AI, Doubao, Alice, GigaChat, CLOVA X and other local assistants are not listed. Example of the gap: StatCounter shows ChatGPT at 42.59% in China in Oct 2026, where ChatGPT is not available - referrals come from the small VPN/overseas population visiting StatCounter-tagged sites.

faq.question: Which AI do Russians use most?
faq.answer: Yandex's Alice AI. Mediascope's September 2026 data show 55% of Russians aged 12 and over used an AI service that month; Alice AI reached about 48%, DeepSeek 11% (13 million people) and Sber's GigaChat 5% (6 million). Microsoft estimated that DeepSeek accounted for 43% of the generative-AI use it could measure in Russia in the second half of 2025. Perplexity's lead in StatCounter data (39.34% in October 2026) measures referrals — clicks from a chatbot answer through to websites that run StatCounter's tracker — not how many people use each assistant; on that measure ChatGPT led from May to September 2026.

methodology_microsoft.definition_quote_q2_2026: we continue to measure AI diffusion as the share of people worldwide ages of 15 and 64 who have used a generative AI product during the reported period. This measure is derived from aggregated and anonymized Microsoft telemetry data and is adjusted to reflect differences in operating system and device market share, internet penetration, and population.
methodology_microsoft.definition_quote_h2_2025: we measure AI diffusion as the share of people worldwide who have used a generative AI product during the reported period. This measure is derived from aggregated and anonymized Microsoft telemetry and then adjusted to reflect differences in OS and device-market share, internet penetration, and country population.
methodology_microsoft.formula_paper: AI User Share = (% of Microsoft users that use AI) x (% of population with a desktop device) x (mobile scaling factor), less estimated desktop/mobile overlap
methodology_microsoft.data_source: Anonymised Microsoft telemetry, primarily Windows desktop (PC/tablet); third-party StatCounter data for Windows market share and mobile/desktop ratios; World Bank WDI (CEIC where missing) for population 15-64.
methodology_microsoft.regional_imputation: Paper, Table 2: economies marked † are a 'Region-imputed estimate due to insufficient telemetry coverage'. Countries below traffic thresholds or with population under 2 million are 'grouped into small regions'; e.g. an East Africa region of Burundi, Eritrea, Ethiopia, Somalia, South Sudan, Sudan, Tanzania and Uganda. 111 of 147 economies have economy-specific estimates.
methodology_microsoft.coverage_caveat_quote: In some countries—like Russia, Iran, and partly China—telemetry data is limited, so usage estimates may be incomplete.
methodology_microsoft.low_opt_in_adjustment: Markets with below-average telemetry opt-in are blended toward the global average ('particularly in parts of Europe').
methodology_microsoft.h1_2025_restatement_check: H1 2025 values in the Q2 2026 dataset equal the paper's Table 2 to two decimals for all 147 economies checked (see verification log) - no restatement.
methodology_microsoft.paper_vs_dataset_china: The paper's text says China's share 'more than doubled from 8% to 20%' after DeepSeek on a 3-month rolling average; its Table 2 (H1 2025) gives 15.40%. Different windows - quote the table/dataset value.
